scope: Learned sequence model (1D CNN) for ball-free possession replacing the five-feature logistic model inside long ball gaps. Trained on Metrica Games 1-3 + DFL J03WMX/J03WN1/J03WOH/J03WOY only; DFL J03WPY/J03WQQ/J03WR9 confirm once. No challenge labels, public-window scores, video or hand labels.
model: cnn3: per-team 32 attack-normalised player-shape summaries at 5 fps, +-3 s window, 1x1 conv -> 3 dilated k=7 convs (48 channels, GELU) -> 1x1 conv; shared per team, logit = f(home) - f(away) (exact antisymmetry). Selected by leave-one-match-out on development matches.

weights.inference: numpy only; max |difference| vs torch 2.3e-6; ~23 s for the challenge match

masked_gap_spell_f1.note: current default base; development values use out-of-fold predictions

weight_choice: 1.0, not 2.0: weight 2.0 raised challenge spells under 1 s from 3 to 5 (under 2 s 26 -> 39) and failed the robustness short-spell check, for at most a marginal external gain.
metrica_guards: 177/180 (recovery-masked spell_f1_0.5 dips 0.0003/0.0002 on Game 2; live-missing 2 s spell_f1_0.75 0.004 on Game 3)
robustness: 132/134 (prototype dead-share drift; noise 0.10 m frame agreement 0.976)
decision: Promoted by the user with disclosed exceptions.
